blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: When a language model answers from a curated corpus via graph-based retrieval, reported grounding uplift mixes delivery of facts already shown with reasoning over injected structure. We propose exposure accounting : classify every gold item by whether the context exposed it and whether the answer recovered it, and report the four counts. The copy ceiling , the recall a verbatim copy of the context achieves, is that table’s scalar and the signed gain over copy its net, both judge-free. Across ten models, unaided recall averages 0.26 and grounded recall 0.92, yet gain over copy is uniformly negative ( − 0.067 -0.067 to − 0.022 -0.022 ). Of 11,360 gold-item observations (1,136 target instances under ten models, not 11,360 independent facts), three unexposed items are recovered. A stratified audit of 423 of those observations, under a cross-family judge and a symmetric quote gate, puts the precision of the matcher’s credit at 0.971 [ 0.941 , 0.986 ] [0.941,0.986] . On 60 unexposed uncredited items the judge finds no hidden correct answer (upper bound 6%); all three unexposed credited items, a census, fail adjudication, so credit beyond exposure is rare and here spurious. Correcting the exposed-item rate for judged relational correctness gives an estimated 0.905 against 0.931 under this judge. On gold targets the scaffold did not expose, lexical recovery falls from 0.121 bare to 0.004 grounded; relational adjudication validates 71 of the 92 bare-arm credits and none of the three grounded-arm credits. Rephrasing out of the graph’s title vocabulary collapses exposure from 0.964 to 0.328, while the absence-keyed fallback fires on 2 of 506. A paired production study lifts judged quality by + 0.27 +0.27 pooled. Negative controls show the served path beating no context, but not that the scaffold’s content matters beyond a well-formed on-corpus block. Evaluations whose gold derives from the injected corpus should report the accounting.
blocks.zh: 当一个语言模型通过基于图表的检索来回答一个教程时,据报告说,在提出事实时,用推理来解释注入的结构。 我们建议进行接触情况核算:将每个黄金项目分类,按其上下文是否披露以及答复是否收回,并报告四项统计。 翻版的上限, 即上下文的逐字记录, 是该表的标尺, 在10种模式中,无援助的召回平均为0.26,有依据召回平均为0.92,但收益高于副本却一致为负值(-0.067-0.67至-0.022-0.022)。 在11 360项黄金物品观察中(10种模式下的目标1 136项,而不是11 360项独立事实),追回了3项未暴露物品。 在一位跨家庭法官和一个对称的引号门下,对其中423项意见进行分级审计后,匹配者的信用精确度为0.971[0.941,0.986][0.941,0.986]。 在60个未曝光的无信用项目上,法官发现没有隐藏的正确答案(最高约束6%);所有3个未曝光的信用项目,一次人口普查,失败裁定,因此超出曝光的信用是罕见的,在这里也是虚假的. 校正经判断的相对正确性的曝光率估计是0.905比0.931。 在黄金目标方面,脚手架没有暴露,从0.121光到0.004光;关系裁决确认了92个赤臂信贷中的71个,三个赤臂信贷中没有一个。 将图中的标题词汇重排后,曝光率从0.964跌至0.328,而无键倒背火则在506的2起. 成对生产研究升降 判断质量+0.27+0.27集合. 负控显示所服务的道路没有上下文, 但没有显示脚手架的内容重要, 注入体中黄金来源的评价应报告会计。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Enterprises need language models to answer from curated, organisation-controlled corpora that pretraining does not reliably cover. Retrieval-augmented generation bridges parametric memory and required knowledge [ 29 , 16 ] , particularly for long-tail and proprietary facts [ 36 ] . Structured, graph-based retrieval further sharpens this approach [ 10 , 19 , 3 , 42 ] . Yet when gold answers derive from the injected corpus, headline “grounding uplift” conflates delivery of exposed facts with reasoning over injected structure. Published knowledge-graph grounding reports lack a standing control that separates them.
blocks.zh: 企业需要语言模型来回答被管理,组织控制的公司,预训不能可靠地涵盖. 检索-增强的一代桥梁参数记忆和所需知识[29,16],特别是长尾和专有事实[36]. 结构化的、以图表为基础的检索进一步强化了这种办法[10、19、3、42]。 然而,当黄金解答来自注入体时,标题“打地基提升”将暴露的事实与注入结构的推理混为一谈。 已公布的知识图定位报告缺乏将它们分开的长期控制。

blocks.en: We introduce exposure accounting , and the copy ceiling 1 1 1 The term copy ceiling is used independently and in an unrelated sense by [ 33 ] (a decoding-layer editing mechanism, where it denotes token reachability under a line-level copy primitive; that work is withdrawn), noted here only to head off a terminology collision. , as its per-item scalar, together with the signed gain over copy . Exposure accounting classifies each gold item by whether the shown text exposed it and whether the answer recovered it, and reports the four resulting counts. The copy ceiling is the recall a no-op extractor of exactly the shown text would achieve, which is the exposed fraction; gain over copy is grounded recall minus that ceiling, which pooled over items is the net of two of the four counts. The counts depend only on a surface matcher applied to fixed text, so they carry the findings; the scalar summarises them. This deterministic, judge-free control is paired with a seed-disjoint placebo, and § 10.2 measures what the determinism costs by auditing the matcher against judged assertions on a stratified sample of the sweep. It generalises the discrete input-only baselines used to interpret reading comprehension [ 25 ] and natural-language inference [ 20 , 46 ] . Grounding evaluations whose gold derives from the injected corpus should report the accounting as standard, with the ceiling as its summary [ 27 , 38 ] .

blocks.en: Without assistance, the evaluated models score 0.265 on average (range 0.151 0.151 – 0.375 0.375 ) on in-domain questions and ≈ 0.92 \approx 0.92 with curated context. Across ten models from eight developer families, gain over copy is uniformly negative ( − 0.067 -0.067 to − 0.022 -0.022 ), while beyond-exposure recovery totals three items in 11,360 item × \times model observations (the same 1,136 target instances scored under each of ten models, § 10.3 ). Models therefore differ almost entirely in how much surfaced gold they drop. A clarification on “private”: the corpus is not secret. It is published on GitHub and at a public site (§ 3 ), so the non-trivial raw scores ( 0.151 0.151 – 0.375 0.375 across models) reflect partial pretraining exposure rather than a genuinely unseen domain; what makes it a useful test bed is that it is organisation-controlled and curated, not that it is hidden. Throughout, “private” denotes the deployment pattern (LAN-confined, no cloud egress), not corpus secrecy. Delivery of an authoritative, human-curated source is the product. Throughout, “delivery” is scored as recall of exposed gold target names and nothing more. Relational correctness is measured separately, on a stratified sample of the sweep under model adjudication (§ 10.2 ); precision of the full answer against fabrication, and the accuracy of the attribution metadata, remain unmeasured here (§ 17 ).

blocks.en: Three methods below are corpus-general and separable from the node they are measured on: the copy-ceiling computation and signed gain over copy (§ 5 , § 7 ); the seed-disjoint placebo construction (§ 5.4 , § 10.7 ); and the blind before/after judged gate for write paths (§ 12.1 ). A fourth, the stratified audit of § 10.2 , is specific to a lexical matcher but transfers to any evaluation that uses one. Release. The served node, the ten-model sweep rows together with the harness that generated them, the exposure decomposition, the production paired study and both of its judge passes, the negative-control completions with both their archived and their re-judged scores, the semantic re-score, the paraphrase stress set and the semantic audit (its sample, its cached judge calls, its summariser and the blind sample prepared for a human pass) are in the repositories footnoted below, under version control, with per-study bootstrap seeds named in the released scripts and a table-to-artefact manifest at docs/research/gain-over-copy-paper/MANIFEST.md . Every table and figure in this paper resolves to an artefact in that manifest. The release supports checking every reported number against saved rows; it does not support full scaffold regeneration, because the corpus-derived scaffold index is not released, and two embedding caches are excluded for size and rebuilt by their own released scripts against the embedding endpoint. The routing companion note (§ 16 ) states its own release gaps, which are not inherited here.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Grounding lineage runs from RAG [ 29 ] through graph-structured retrieval [ 10 , 19 ] and zero-shot knowledge-graph triple prompting [ 3 ] to roadmaps and surveys [ 42 , 45 ] . GraphRAG addresses “private and/or previously unseen” collections [ 10 ] , while enterprise variants highlight amortised curation [ 37 ] . Published work typically injects instance triples or opaque encodings, including community summaries [ 10 ] and GNN soft-prompts over retrieved subgraphs [ 21 ] ; we instead inject human-readable, schema-level content: class definitions, typed relations and taxonomy. None of these graph-grounding studies reports a standing input-exposure control beside its uplift figures, so their headline uplift is not re-centred on content already present in context, though where retrieval coverage is reported a reader can approximate the subtraction from their published quantities.
blocks.zh: 从RAG[29]到图结构检索[10,19]和零镜头知识图三重提示[3]到路线图和调查[42,45]。 GraphRAG处理的是“私人和/或先前未见的”收藏[10],而企业的变体则强调摊销管理[37]。 出版的作品一般会注入实例三重或不透明编码,包括社区摘要[10]和GNN软速率通过检索子图[21];我们转而注入人可读的,计划层次的内容:类定义,打字关系和分类学. 这些以图表为基础的研究中,没有一个报告除了其上升数字外,还有一种固定的输入-接触控制,因此其标题的上升并没有重新以上下文中已经出现的内容为中心,尽管在报告检索范围时,读者可以大致从其公布的数量中扣除。

blocks.en: Simple controls can overturn headline results: strong RAG baselines match elaborate pipelines under equal token budgets [ 27 ] ; controlled comparisons reverse earlier “RAG wins” findings and add a confidence router [ 31 ] ; and apparent argument comprehension can reflect spurious cues [ 41 ] . The confidence router of [ 31 ] and selective retrieval [ 2 , 23 , 36 ] provide precedents for our injection gate. Those methods choose whether to retrieve; ours chooses whether to inject.
blocks.zh: 简单的控制可以推翻头条结果:强大的RAG基线在等价预算下匹配精心设计的管道[27];控制比较可以扭转早先的“RAG胜诉”结论,并增加一个信任路由器[31];而明显的论据理解可以反映虚假提示[41]。 [31]的置信路由器和选择性检索[2,23,36]为我们注射门提供了先例. 这些方法选择是否回收;我们的选择是否注入。

blocks.en: Our copy ceiling extends this tradition. Passage-only, question-only [ 25 ] and hypothesis-only baselines [ 20 , 46 ] reveal shortcuts present in inputs; unlike these discrete task classifiers, the copy ceiling is continuous and per-item. Faithfulness can be measured separately from correctness [ 12 , 1 , 57 ] ; metric-first evaluations formalise assumptions [ 38 ] and test shortcut robustness [ 15 ] . FActScore’s source precision and Adlakha’s token-overlap K-Precision resemble our exposure count, and ALCE rejects “copy the passage” as a shortcut where we use it as the reference point. Contamination audits [ 48 , 17 ] assess input-visible score post hoc, whereas we define deliberate exposure as the reference a priori. The closest ancestry is the extractive-oracle and lead- n n baselines of neural summarisation [ 50 , 39 ] , which likewise ask what a copy of the input already achieves.
blocks.zh: 我们的复制天花板延续了这个传统. 与这些离散的任务分类器不同的是,复制上限是连续的和逐项的. 忠诚度可以与正确度分别衡量[12, 1, 57]; 度量第一评价将假设正规化[38],测试捷径稳健度[15]. FActScore的源精度和Adlakha的标志性重叠的K-精度与我们接触量类似, ALCE拒绝将“复制通过”作为我们使用它作为参照点的捷径。 污染审计[48、17] 评估输入可见分数后的临时情况,而我们则将故意接触定为先验参考。 最亲近的祖先是神经聚变的采掘-甲骨文和n- n 基线[50,39],它同样询问输入的拷贝已经实现什么.

blocks.en: Closest in method is work that causally manipulates the gold answer to test its effect on retrieval-augmented gains [ 30 ] ; that work is withdrawn, and we adopt only its paired-intervention method . Leakage-free benchmarks instead extract reasoning graphs from question–context pairs and apply type-constrained entity replacement with leakage filters [ 32 ] , during corpus construction rather than as a per-item measurement. RAGChecker decomposes RAG quality into claim-level retrieval and generation scores through LLM extraction and grading [ 47 ] ; our context utilisation is a deterministic, surface-matched version of its metric and we claim no originality for the decomposition. MIRAGE measures benchmark-level adaptability against oracle context across retriever–model pairings [ 44 ] . Judged arms use a cross-family judge to limit self-preference [ 56 , 43 ] .
blocks.zh: 方法上最接近的工作是因果操纵金子解答来测试其对回收-增益的影响[30];这项工作被撤回,我们只采用其配对干预方法。 无泄漏基准从问题中提取推理图-对文本并应用受类型约束的实体替换渗漏滤波器[32],在实体构造中而不是作为逐项测量. RAGChecker通过LLM提取和分级将RAG的质量分解为索赔级别的检索和生成分数[47];我们的背景利用是其度量的确定性、表面匹配的版本,我们声称分解没有原创性。 MIRAGE通过检索器-型号配对来测量基准水平相对于甲骨文背景的适应性[44]. 裁判武器使用跨家庭法官限制自我偏爱[56,43].

blocks.en: Against the three closest instruments we claim narrower ground than a new construct: RAGChecker’s context utilisation already performs the exposure/delivery decomposition, via LLM claim extraction rather than a deterministic matcher [ 47 ] ; the reader–context diagnostic already reports graded, judge-free answer presence in packed context, validated by intervention [ 4 ] , and is the closest comparator overall; and Sufficient Context already shows that context-derivable-answer sufficiency is a stronger and better-validated criterion than raw answer-string presence [ 24 ] . Our contribution is an inexpensive, deterministic, judge-free diagnostic and a reporting convention: four-count accounting with a signed copy-baseline scalar, a copy-as-answer invariant, a seed-disjoint placebo, and a stratified audit that prices what the matcher gives up, together with the failure modes we document and the decisions they change. It is not priority over any one component, nor a general boundary between copying and reasoning.
blocks.zh: 对照我们所主张的三种最接近的仪器,比新的构造要狭窄:RAGChecker的上下文利用已经通过LLM索赔提取来进行曝光/交付分解,而不是确定匹配者[47];阅读者-context诊断已经报告分级,在组合的上下文中无法官回答存在,并经过干预[4]验证,是比较最近的整体;足够的上下文已经表明,上下文可辨认的答案充足性比原始答案字符串存在更有力、更具有有效性的标准[24]。 我们的贡献是低成本的、决定性的、无法官的诊断和报告公约:四点计数会计,用一个签名的复制底片,一个重复回答的不变量,一个种子不相干的安慰剂,以及一个分层审计,对配对者放弃的东西以及我们记录的失败模式和它们改变的决定进行定价。 它不优先于任何一个组成部分,也不是复制和推理之间的一般界限。

blocks.en: 3.1 Ecosystem in brief
blocks.zh: 3.1 生态系统简介

blocks.en: Knowledge enters through the knowledgeGraph repository: 8,138 Logseq markdown pages compiled losslessly into a pure-TBox OWL 2 ontology of 8,146 classes and no individuals, published as versioned generations. Content comes from human-directed authorship and, more recently, automated extraction through a preview-first import that refuses overwrites and emits review candidates rather than publishing machine output [ 18 ] . A CI gate combines consistency tests with a Whelk OWL 2 EL reasoner [ 5 ] , rejecting contradictions before publication; each generation ships its reasoned closure of 282,492 triples.

blocks.en: Loom , the measured node, mirrors and serves a generation, combining lexical retrieval over class titles, confidence-gated injection of per-IRI markdown blocks, read-only SPARQL over the closure and delegation to the local model through an OpenAI-compatible façade, currently Qwen3.8-27B on two workstation GPUs. This is the subject of every measurement below.

blocks.en: Loom is one component of a larger stack, and two of the others matter here because the write-path results are only reproducible against them. Ingestion and the ledger writer of § 13 run in the VisionFlow agent environment, where the podcast extraction of § 12 executes; admission to the served corpus runs through the graph’s governed propose/approve path, the ontology-bridge component of the same stack. Figure 1 draws the read path around the measured node and § 13 the write path: the instrument is corpus-general, but the write-path study is only checkable where the write path lives.

blocks.en: Behind these choices sit five deployment requirements: curation the organisation controls, human auditability at single-entity granularity, accelerators that may locate the served markdown unit but never stand in for it, LAN confinement with the model delegated by URL, and confidence-gated injection. Jointly they demand high recall where the corpus is authoritative, with attribution metadata whose precision is itself unmeasured (§ 15 ), and no regression on general questions the model already answers.

blocks.en: 4 Ontology Scaffold
blocks.zh: 4 肿瘤脚手架

blocks.en: Our deployed serving node is a single static Rust binary built as a hexagonal workspace: a domain core defining the port traits, one adapter per backend, a scaffold-policy module and a thin HTTP façade. Only the domain core mints a served unit, so no adapter can return its own row, triple or vector as the payload, and golden fixtures pin retrieval, gating and scaffold serialisation byte-for-byte to a reference implementation.
blocks.zh: 我们部署的服务节点是作为六边形工作空间建造的单一静态Rust二进制:一个域芯,定义端口特征,每个后端一个适配器,一个脚手架政策模块和一个薄的HTTP外观. 只有域芯薄荷能将一个服务单元,所以任何适配器都不能将自己的行,三重或矢量作为有效载荷返回,金色的定点针回收,格子化和脚手架序列化字节换为参考执行.

blocks.en: The unit of service and review is a markdown-with-ontology block scoped to one IRI: curated research prose preceded by typed relations ( subClassOf , requires , enables , uses , relatedTo , contrastsWith ). The corpus is a single sha-addressable generation , here 8,146 concept classes and 282,492 triples in the Whelk-reasoned closure, mirrored atomically so the node serves a known, mixed-build-free version. Unlike approaches that reduce knowledge to opaque community summaries or GNN-encoded subgraphs [ 10 , 21 ] , this system keeps reviewable markdown as the durable asset and lets the accelerators only locate, rank or attest to it [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 服务与审查的单位是一个与肿瘤学相关的块,范围为IRI:在输入关系(subClassOf, required, conference, uses, conversionTo, conversitysWith )之前,经过整理的研究流言。 教程是单一的 shan-addressable 一代, 这里有8,146个概念类 和282,492个三进制 在Whelk 合理关闭, 镜像在原子上,所以节点服务 一个已知的, 混合建设的无版本。 与将知识降低为不透明的社区摘要或GNN编码子图[10,21]的方法不同,这个系统保持可审查的标记降为持久资产,让加速器只定位,排位或证明[9].

blocks.en: We treat exposure accounting as the paper’s central contribution and the copy ceiling as its reportable scalar, and we therefore provide a formal definition of both, an explicit list of assumptions, and a dedicated robustness design, in line with the metric-first precedent [ 38 , 15 ] . The order matters: the scalar is what a reader will quote, but the accounting is what survives a change of implementation.

blocks.en: The accounting is not a test for the presence of reasoning, and no result in this paper should be read as one. Consider a context stating that A A requires B B , that B B has part C C , and that D D has part E E , and a question asking for a part of something A A requires. Choosing C C requires following two relations, yet C C is already a string in the context, so exposure is 1, a perfect answer scores 1, and gain over copy is exactly zero. Zero gain is therefore compatible with successful reasoning over exposed names, and negative gain with reasoning that sometimes fails; positive gain is compatible with memorisation, guessing or matcher asymmetry. The example generalises: wherever a curated corpus is served one entity-scoped block at a time, the names an answer needs are usually already on the page, and a recall metric over those names cannot see which route the model took to them. The defensible statement is the narrow one, this recall score does not establish reasoning beyond answer-name exposure , and establishing whether a model composes exposed structure needs a second instrument that varies the route while holding the answer name exposed. This paper does not run that instrument; it separates the two rather than conflating them, and § 10.2 shows empirically where the exposure instrument stops, since roughly one credited item in sixty names the gold target without asserting the relation the question asked for. Figure 2 illustrates the two paths compared.

blocks.en: A positive delivery result might reflect lexical overlap rather than knowledge transfer. Four arms hold the model and question fixed while perturbing only the injected block (defined here; results in § 10.7 ): true the block served by the node, injected into the bare model. It should reproduce the live loom arm, showing that the serving path adds nothing beyond the block. shuffled the same block with body sentences shuffled. Whole-sentence shuffling preserves every within-sentence fact, so this arm tests sensitivity to sentence order only. masked the same block with every seed-class title replaced by Entity- k k . Answer-bearing target names remain, so this probes dependence on seed naming, not on answer-name matching. irrelevant the well-formed, on-corpus scaffold of a different question, using a fixed derangement over engaged items. Seed-IRI disjointness is a construction check: it prevents donor and target sharing seed classes, but does not by itself guarantee that the donor block exposes none of the target’s gold, ancestors or synonyms (§ 10.7 ). Survival would show that any ontology-shaped text suffices. Each arm answers a different question. Shuffled and masked ask whether sentence order and seed naming carry any of the effect. Irrelevant asks whether the specific retrieved content matters beyond the presence of a well-formed, on-corpus block: it is the content floor, and because it is a real scaffold for a real question it holds register and provenance fixed, though not token count. Together they test whether the observed lift is content-specific, which is the direct analogue of a shortcut-robustness check for a faithfulness metric [ 15 ] . Results are in § 10.7 .

blocks.en: 5.5 Relation to prior instruments
blocks.zh: 5.5 与以往文书的关系

blocks.en: Three recent instruments ask a related question, did the shown context deliver the answer, and § 2 concedes precedent on each component. What remains to place is the position of this instrument among them. RAGChecker’s context utilisation performs the same decomposition through LLM claim extraction and entailment checking [ 47 ] ; restricting it to a deterministic surface matcher buys zero judge cost and exact reproducibility, and costs semantic discrimination. The reader–context diagnostic is the nearest neighbour, scoring graded, judge-free answer presence in packed context [ 4 ] ; the distinction is accounting and apparatus, not the underlying presence idea. Sufficient Context asks a strictly stronger question, whether an answer is derivable from the context at all, and its ablation shows that criterion beating a ground-truth-string-in-context baseline, 93 % 93\% against 81 % 81\% agreement [ 24 ] ; our exposure ceiling is deliberately that weaker baseline. The idea of an input-side reference is older still: the extractive-oracle tradition in summarisation [ 50 , 39 , 53 ] makes a copy of the input the natural reference for any recall-style metric, and an information-bottleneck view compresses retrieved context against the answer for a related purpose [ 58 ] . The trade-off is explicit and is the reason § 10.2 exists: removing semantic judgement removes semantic discrimination, so the ceiling is read as a delivery-recall reference and the audit prices what that reading omits.

blocks.en:
Because the matcher is lexical, a sceptic can ask whether the negative gain is an artefact of strict
matching: the answer paraphrases gold that the ceiling, computed on the same matcher, happens to
catch. We re-score every saved sweep row with a paraphrase-tolerant embedding matcher, re-scoring the
copy ceiling under the identical matcher so the comparison stays symmetric. The matcher embeds
candidate spans (word 1–6-grams within delimiter-bounded chunks, plus each chunk and the whole text)
with bge-small-en-v1.5 and scores a gold item as recovered when the maximum cosine against
its title meets a threshold; we sweep thresholds 0.80 / 0.85 / 0.90 0.80/0.85/0.90 and use the paper’s seeded
10,000-resample paired bootstrap. The copy contexts here are reconstructed , not shown byte-identical to the
contexts of the original sweep: the released rows store each question’s exposure count rather than
its context string. They are regenerated with the frozen scaffold engine and admitted only under an
equivalence gate, which requires every question’s recomputed exposed-gold count to equal the count
stored on its sweep row and the mean lexical ceiling to agree to four decimal places ( 0.9645 0.9645 ).
Two further quantities match the original run: the regenerated set yields 778 gold titles, the
figure that run recorded, and a 126-item sanity sample of lexical hits agrees with semantic scoring
at 100% at every threshold. That gate is an equivalence check on exposure and on lexical scoring.
Two texts with equal lexical exposure may still be worded differently, and embedding-match
behaviour could differ between them, so this is a re-score on reconstructed contexts rather than on
the original bytes.

blocks.en: This control is cheap to adopt because it needs no model. To compute it on any corpus: 1. Inputs. A list of questions, each with a gold target set (the {slug, title} pairs the source asserts as its answer) and the exact context string S i S_{i} that would be shown to the model. The ceiling needs a gold target set appropriate to the question and a matching criterion suited to it (assumption A4); shared provenance between gold and context is not required, though it is the case where the exposure confound bites hardest. 2. Matcher. A deterministic surface matcher m ⁡ ( t , X ) \mathrm{m}(t,X) : one when the normalised title of gold item t t , or ≥ 80 % \geq 80\% of its length- ≥ 4 \geq 4 words, appears in X X . The reference implementation and the scaffold engine used here are released in the harness ( tools/paper/decompose_exposure.py and ontology_scaffold_v1.py ); a paraphrase-tolerant embedding variant is a drop-in (§ 6 ). 3. Compute, no model call. Per question, the copy ceiling is c i = ( ∑ t ∈ G i m ⁡ ( t , S i ) ) / | G i | c_{i}=\bigl(\sum_{t\in G_{i}}\mathrm{m}(t,S_{i})\bigr)/|G_{i}| : the fraction of gold already exposed in the context. The headline is the mean over questions. Grounded recall r i r_{i} reuses the same matcher on the model’s answer; gain over copy is r i − c i r_{i}-c_{i} . Reading the number. A ceiling near 1 ( 0.964 0.964 here) says the context already contains the answer strings, so retrieval supplies most of the coverage. The exposure reference then belongs beside the quality and system baselines a generative component is judged on, not in place of them: positive gain over copy is not a prerequisite for useful generation, and a component that restates a curated source faithfully is doing its job at a gain of zero. A ceiling near 0.5 0.5 or below says the answer strings are largely missing, which may mean the task genuinely requires composition, or equally that retrieval failed, that the question was phrased out of vocabulary (§ 8 ), that gold is incomplete or that the matcher missed. In both directions the number is a prioritisation heuristic that tells you where to look first, not a classifier of what the model is doing, and it never says that the required relation is present. A worked question, its gold and a sample scaffold block are in Appendix B .

The specific, supported prescription is that a hybrid
gate must be keyed to retrieval confidence rather than to retrieval presence : presence
is satisfied on 99.6 % 99.6\% of paraphrases while exposure is lost on 64.4 % 64.4\% of them. Whether semantic
seeds should then replace lexical ones or be appended to them under a fixed token budget is
not measured here, and three considerations argue against replacing them wholesale. On entity and
rare-token queries dense retrieval is the fragile arm and lexical matching holds
up [ 49 ] , so the safe form gates on query type or on dense-versus-lexical rank
disagreement and fuses the rankings [ 6 ] . Score-distribution predictors are weakest
precisely on semantic queries and cannot see a confident-but-wrong lexical seed [ 13 ] ,
so the informative key is disagreement between the two retrievers rather than a single-ranking
confidence score. And the collapse reported here is a retrieval- exposure measurement, whether
the block reaches the model at all, not the model’s answer robustness: the paraphrase-robustness
literature reports single-digit accuracy drops [ 35 ] because it measures a different
construct downstream of successful retrieval, and the two figures are not comparable. Within the
paper’s framing the ceiling again does the work: it shows where exposure is lost, measures what a
semantic path could recover, and prices the design that would recover it.

blocks.zh: 9 方法

blocks.en: Both studies use within-model pairs: the same model answers the same question twice, cancelling between-question difficulty variance. The sweep varies the model with grounding fixed; the production study varies the serving path with the model fixed.
blocks.zh: 两个研究都使用模型内对:同一个模型两次回答同一个问题,取消了问题间难度差异. 扫荡方式在固定地面的情况下改变模型;生产研究在固定模型的情况下改变服务路径.

blocks.en: The knowledge graph supplies templated questions for every sufficiently-defined class: T-REL (requirements, uses, dependencies, enablers, and parts), T-TAX (immediate and ancestral parents), and T-COMMON (shared ancestors of a pair). Gold answers are the {slug, title} targets asserted by the graph. Seed 42 yields 510 questions across 15 domains: 285 T-REL, 180 T-TAX, and 45 T-COMMON. Each is posed raw and scaffold (with a budget-clamped 1,500-token ontology extract prepended) to ten models from eight developer families (Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, Zhipu, DeepSeek, Meta, Alibaba, Mistral), accessed through their providers’ APIs or a router, under one fixed configuration ( temperature =0, max_tokens =2048; reasoning_effort =low only where thinking cannot be disabled, preventing mandatory passes from truncating answers). The lexical matcher from § 5 counts a gold item when its normalised title, or ≥ 80 % \geq 80\% of its long words, appears in the answer. The matcher is a surface proxy that can both over-count and under-count, so absolute recall is not a bound in either direction (A2); the signal is the explicitly lexical paired delta for the same question, scorer, and model. Truncation is detected per row: GLM-4.6 truncated on 174 rows, of which 5 were retried and the rest scored as received, making that row lower-confidence, and Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite on 16.

blocks.en: Two properties of the instrument bound every number the sweep reports. First, the matcher tests for the presence of a gold target’s name. It does not test that the answer asserts the right relation, that subject and object are the right way round, that the answer is not simultaneously denying the relationship, or that it is not an unusably broad list; an answer can therefore score fully while being relationally wrong. Using the same matcher on context and on answer does not guarantee that such errors cancel, because structured scaffold text and generated prose differ in length and syntax. § 10.2 measures this gap directly on a stratified sample of the sweep and reports both the rate and the mechanisms. Second, the gold sets are not uniformly conjunctive: T-COMMON (45 of 510 questions, of which 17 carry two or more acceptable targets) accepts any one of several valid targets, while the item-level decomposition counts each target separately. A model can therefore give a fully acceptable answer and still accumulate exposed-but-omitted items, so item-level omission counts include some compliant omissions; § 10.3 recounts them and § 10.2 checks that recount against judged assertions. Separating required components, interchangeable acceptable answers and optional additions in the gold sets is outstanding work.
blocks.zh: 仪表的两个属性 绑定每个编号 扫描报告。 首先,火柴测试金靶名字的存在. 它不测试答案是否坚持正确的关系,主题和对象是正确的回合,答案不是在同时否认关系,或者它不是一个不可否认的广义列表;因此一个答案可以在关系错误的同时完全得分. 在上下文和回答上使用相同的匹配器并不能保证这种错误被取消,因为结构化的脚手架文字和生成的流言在长度和语法上是不同的. §10.2直接根据分级的扫描样本衡量这一差距,并报告速率和机制。 第二,金套不是统一的交集:T-COMMON(510个问题中的45个,其中17个携带两个或两个以上可接受的目标)接受几个有效目标中的任何一个,而物品级分解分别计算每个目标. 因此,一个模型可以给出一个完全可以接受的答案,并且仍然积累被披露但被披露的项目,因此项目层面的遗漏计数包括一些符合规定的遗漏;§10.3重述了这些遗漏,以及§10.2对照判断的断言重新计数的检查. 分离所需组件、可互换的可接受答案和在黄金套件中可选的添加是未完成的工作。

blocks.en: We hold the model constant at Qwen3.8-27B on the reference GPU host, isolating the serving path. The loom arm calls the production Rust node’s /v1/chat/completions endpoint, which retrieves, confidence-gates and injects the scaffold, returning telemetry (engagement, injected tokens, fusion path) in the response loom block. The raw arm calls the same backend without a scaffold. Both use temperature =0 and max_tokens =1536, below which the reasoning backend truncates output to empty. Three pre-generation frozen sets contain 117 questions: 24 arcane (deep in-domain), 33 thin (sparsely covered), and 60 general (out-of-domain). The general set is also graded by the out-of-domain judged arm below, keeping the judged arms comparable. The negative-control arms from § 5.4 use the same node; their scaffolds come from the LLM-free /loom/scaffold endpoint, so each control presents the bare model, via a system message, with exactly the block bytes served to the loom arm.

blocks.en: Per set and pooled, the primary metric is the paired mean difference with a seeded 10,000-resample bootstrap 95% percentile interval [ 11 , 26 ] . Alongside it we report a two-sided exact conditional signed-rank test, which targets a rank summary rather than the mean and is therefore complementary: zero differences are dropped (the reduced-sample procedure, not Pratt’s), tied absolute differences receive average ranks, and the p p -value comes from exact enumeration of the sign-randomisation distribution conditional on the observed ranks, which matters because one set has only two non-zero pairs. The paired effect size is the matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation r = ( T + − T − ) / ( T + + T − ) r=(T^{+}-T^{-})/(T^{+}+T^{-}) over non-tied pairs. Set-level p p -values receive a Holm–Bonferroni correction [ 8 ] . For out-of-domain non-regression we use a conservative interval-inclusion criterion in the spirit of equivalence testing [ 28 ] : non-regression is declared only when the 95% bootstrap percentile interval lies wholly inside a pre-specified ± 0.25 \pm 0.25 margin, which is stricter than the 90% interval conventional TOST would use. Because in-domain graph-derived questions cluster by class and domain [ 8 ] , we report a domain-clustered block bootstrap alongside the naive interval and an intention-to-treat delta retaining questions where the gate did not engage [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 每套和集合,主要衡量尺度是配对的平均差值,其种子为10 000-再样品的靴子间隔为95%[11,26]。 我们同时报告一个双面的、精确的签名排名测试,该测试针对的是军衔汇总,而不是中位数,因此是互补的:零差异被放弃(减少的抽样程序,而不是普拉特的程序),绑定的绝对差异得到平均排名,p值来自精确的点出以被观察到的军衔为条件的标志随机分布,这很重要,因为一个军衔只有两个非零对。 配对效应大小是配对-pairs leader-biserial r = (T + – T →) / (T + + T →) r = (T + + T → → ) / (T + + + T → → ) 相对于非配对. set-level p - values gets a Holm–Bonferroni 更正 [8]. 对于域外不退缩,我们本着等效测试的精神使用保守的间隔包含标准[28]: 只有当95%的拖带百分位间隔完全位于预先指定的± 0.25\pm 0.25差值内时,才宣布不退缩,这比常规TOST使用的90%间隔更严格。 由于域内图表衍生的问题按类别和领域分类[8],我们报告一个域内集群的块状靴子,同时报告一个天真间隔和一个意图处理三角洲问题,保留大门没有参与的问题[22]。

blocks.en: 10 Results
blocks.zh: 10 结果

blocks.en: At max_tokens =1536, 42 of 234 loom/raw completions, spanning 28 question pairs, exhausted the budget during reasoning and produced no output. Each affected pair was re-executed at 4096 in both arms; three thin questions still came back empty in one arm (loom once, raw twice, so realised missingness was not symmetric) and were excluded pairwise, giving a complete-case n = 114 n=114 . The pooled contrast is therefore a mixed-budget estimand: 25 re-run pairs at 4096 and 89 at 1536. The control arms of § 10.7 remained at 1536 and lost 36 36 – 50 % 50\% of their completions the same way, which is accounted for there.
blocks.zh: 在最大值=1536时,234个终端/绘图完成中,有42个完成,涉及28个问题对,推理时预算耗尽,没有产出。 每个受影响的对子在双臂的4096分被重新执行;三个细小的问题仍然在一只手臂中空出(一次,两次生,所以意识到的缺失不是对称的),并且被排除成对,给出了一个完整的大小写n=114n=114. 因此,集合对比是一个混合预算估计:25对重跑对,4096,89对1536。 §10.7的控制武器仍为1536,损失了36 36 - 50% - 50%的完成量,其计算方式相同。

blocks.en: 10.1 In-domain: recall against exposure
blocks.zh: 10.1 域内:防止接触

blocks.en: For Gemini 3.7 Flash, raw recall is 0.375 and scaffold recall 0.942, a paired delta of + 0.567 \mathbf{+0.567} with naive and domain-clustered 95% CIs of [ + 0.532 , + 0.603 ] [+0.532,+0.603] and [ + 0.524 , + 0.611 ] [+0.524,+0.611] , respectively, across n = 510 n=510 items; there were no errors or truncated responses. The low raw score is consistent with a domain only partially covered by pretraining (the corpus is public, so some exposure is expected; § 1 ). The copy ceiling is 0.964 , placing recall − 0.022 -0.022 below the question-averaged exposed fraction. (That macro ceiling is not the item-pooled exposed fraction, 0.933 0.933 ; the two are reported separately and are not interchangeable, § 17 .) The model therefore returns most curated answers and omits some. Because recall does not measure additions beyond the gold, fabrication and attribution precision remain unmeasured (§ 15 ); § 10.2 measures whether a credited name is asserted in the relation the question asks for.
blocks.zh: 双子座3.7 Flash, 生召回是 0. 375, 脚手架召回 0. 942, 双三角形为 + 567\ mathbf\ 0.567}, 天真和域集群的 CI 95% 分别是 [ + 0. 532, + 0. 603] [ + 0. 524, + 0. 611] [ + 0. 524, + 0. 611] , 横跨 n = 510 n = 510 项; 没有错误或截断接的答复. 低生分数与预训只涵盖的部分域一致(本书是公开的,因此预计会有一些曝光;§1). 拷贝上限为0.964,将召回-0.022-0.022置于问题平均暴露分数之下。 (宏观上限不是项目集合的暴露分数,0.933 0.933;两者分开报告,不能互换,§17。 ) 因此,该模型返回了最完整的答案,并省略了一些答案。 由于召回并不衡量黄金以外的添加,因此制造和归属精确度仍未计量(第15节);第10.2节衡量在问题要求的关系中是否主张贷记名称。

blocks.en: 10.2 Semantic audit of the matcher
blocks.zh: 10.2 对匹配者的语义审计

blocks.en: Our matcher tests for the presence of a gold target’s name. It does not test that the answer asserts the right relation, that subject and object are the right way round, or that the answer is not denying the relationship. This section measures how far that gap moves the numbers, on the released sweep itself.
blocks.zh: 我们的匹配者测试金靶子名字的存在。 它不测试答案是否坚持正确的关系,主题和对象是否是正确的回合方式,或者答案不是否认关系. 本节衡量这一空白在所释放的扫描中移动数字的幅度。

blocks.en: The unit is a (question, model, gold item) triple in the scaffold arm, and the frame is every such unit in the ten-model sweep: 510 questions, ten models, 11,360 11{,}360 units. Regenerating the exposure classification from the frozen question set and the scaffold index reproduces the released decomposition exactly ( n 11 = 9,865 n_{11}=9{,}865 , n 10 = 735 n_{10}=735 , n 01 = 3 n_{01}=3 , n 00 = 757 n_{00}=757 ), which is the gate the sample is drawn behind. Sampling is stratified by matcher category, then within each category over (template × \times gold type) cells proportionally to cell size, then over models within each cell, then simple random sampling without replacement, under seed 42. The result is 423 units : 240 of the 9,865 credited-and-exposed, 120 of the 735 exposed-and-omitted, 60 of the 757 unexposed-and-uncredited, and a census of all 3 unexposed-and-credited. Exposure is model-independent, so the unexposed strata are 76 distinct items repeated across ten models and are not independent observations.
blocks.zh: 该单元是脚手架臂部的三重(问,型,金项),构架是十式扫荡中的每一个这样的单元:510问,10型,1136011{,}360个单元. 从冷冻问题集中重新生成曝光分类,脚手架指数完全复制释放的分解(n 11=9 865) n_{11}=9{,}865 ,n 10 = 735 n_{10}=735 ,n 01 = 3 n_{01}=3,n 00 757 n_{00}=757 ),是标本绘制后方的大门. 取样按配对者类别进行分级,然后在每一类别内(模板×\时金型)的细胞与细胞大小成正比,然后在每个细胞内的模型之上,然后在42种种子下进行简单的随机取样而不进行替换。 结果是423个单位:9,865个入库和出库的240个单位,735个出库和出库的120个单位,757个出库和出库的60个单位,以及全部3个出库和出库的普查. 接触是模式独立的,因此未暴露的层层是76个不同的项目,在10个模型中重复,不是独立的观测.

blocks.en: Each unit is put to openai/gpt-4.1 at temperature 0 through OpenRouter, with the question, the gold edge, the full gold set, whether the question requires all or any one of it, and the answer. The rubric asks for one of six labels: correct_relation , name_only , wrong_relation , reversed , negated , absent , with a fixed precedence order, plus whether the item is required or an accepted alternative, a confidence, and a verbatim quote. All 423 units returned a parseable verdict, two after a single formatting re-ask; every call is cached by a sha256 of judge model, rubric and prompt, so re-running returns identical verdicts. The total adjudication cost was $0.93. The adjudicator is a model, not a human. It is cross-family to nine of the ten swept models and the same family as the tenth, gpt-4.1-mini , whose row therefore carries a self-preference risk the others do not; the per-model breakdown is released so a reader can check it, and the blind 120-unit sample and annotation guide for a human pass are released unannotated.
blocks.zh: 每个单元在0度温度下通过OpenRouter被放入Openai/gpt-4.1,其中包含问题,金边,全金套装,问题是否需要全部或任意一个,以及答案. 标题要求六个标签中的一个: 正确_ relation, name_ only, 错误_ relation, 反转 , 否定 , 缺席 , 有固定的优先级顺序, 加上项目是需要还是被接受的选项, 信心, 以及逐字记录 。 所有423个单位都退回了可解析的判决,两个在一次格式化的重新任务之后;每个电话被一个sha256法官模型缓存,标注和迅速,所以重新运行返回相同的判决. 裁定费用总额为0.93美元。 裁判员是模型,不是人类. 它与十种横扫模型中的九种是跨家族的,与第十种是同一家族的gpt-4.1-mini,因此其行带有自我偏爱的风险,其他人不这样做;每个模型的分解被发布,以便读者可以检查,盲120单元样本和人类通行证注释指南被发布时没有附加说明.

blocks.en: Every non- absent verdict must cite a verbatim span of the answer, and the audit checks that span under the matcher’s own normalisation. The policy is one policy for every failed citation, and it never consults the matcher’s own category, so credited and uncredited strata are treated alike. A verdict whose cited span cannot be found in the answer is put back to the judge once, with the rubric and the item unchanged, asking for a span that occurs verbatim; a verdict that still fails to supply one is marked unresolved rather than silently kept or silently demoted. Of 281 verdicts required to cite, 252 verify at the first pass, and the 29 that do not are adjudicated under that one policy: 11 are repaired by a re-asked span that verifies, and on the other 18 the judge conceded that no supporting span exists. Repairs and concessions fall along the strata: all 11 repairs are in the credited stratum, 6 verifying character for character and 5 under the matcher’s own normalisation; all 18 concessions are in the uncredited strata, 14 in n 10 n_{10} and 4 in n 00 n_{00} . A re-asked span is accepted when it matches the answer character for character, or under the matcher’s own whitespace and punctuation normalisation, which keeps the gate no stricter than the policy it replaces; both flags are recorded per unit in the released log. Under a strictly verbatim rule the five normalisation-only repairs would be unresolved instead, all five in the credited stratum and all carrying a correct_relation verdict, and credit precision would read 0.950 0.950 ( 228 / 240 228/240 ) against the matcher, 0.971 0.971 ( 233 / 240 233/240 ) for it and 0.970 0.970 ( 228 / 235 228/235 ) with them excluded. Every rate below is read three ways, which bounds what the unresolved verdicts can do to it: taking each unresolved verdict at its word, counting it as absent , and dropping it from its stratum’s denominator. Under the acceptance rule as run, credited-item rates are invariant across all three, precision of credit holding at 0.971 0.971 ; the omission rates move, and are quoted with that spread where they appear.
blocks.zh: 每个非缺席裁决都必须引用一个逐字的答案范围,以及在匹配者自身正常化下进行的审计检查。 这项政策是针对每一次失败的报价的一个政策,它从不咨询匹配者自己的类别,因此信用和无信用阶层受到同等待遇。 在答复中无法找到所引用期限的判决,将一次提交法官,其标题和项目不变,要求有一个按字逐句出现的期限;一项仍未提供期限的判决显然没有得到解决,而不是保持沉默或默默降级。 在需要援引的281项判决中,有252项在第一次通过时予以核实,29项未根据一项政策作出裁定:11项由重新要求的核查周期修复,另外18项法官承认不存在支持周期。 修理和特许属于等级等级:所有11项修理都属于记账等级,6项核查品格,5项在火柴本身的正常化下;所有18项特许属于无证等级,14项在n 10n_{10}和4项在n 00n_{00}。 在匹配字符的回答字符时,或者在匹配者自己的白空间和圆点正常化下,重新请求的跨度被接受,这保持了大门不比它所取代的策略更严格;两种旗帜都记录在已发布的日志中。 根据严格的逐字记录规则,只进行5次正常化修理将无法解决,这5次修理将全部解决,而所有5次修理在入帐层中,均作出正确关系判决,信贷精确度将改为对火柴的0.950 0.950(228 / 240 228/240),其中0.971 0.971(233/240),0.970(228 /228/235),不包括这些修理。 下面的每个比率都读作三种方式,这些方式决定了未解决的判决可以对它做什么:按其言行作出每个未解决的判决,算作缺席,并把它从层分母中去掉。 根据运行中的接受规则,所有三种情况下的信贷项目利率都不一致,信贷持有的精度为0.971 0.971;省略利率变动,并随其出现的差幅而引用。

blocks.en: Table 2 gives the confusion (upper panel). Of the 240 credited items, 233 233 are judged to assert the gold edge: precision of credit 0.971 \mathbf{0.971} [ 0.941 , 0.986 ] [0.941,0.986] . Four ( 0.017 0.017 [ 0.006 , 0.042 ] [0.006,0.042] ) name the target without asserting the asked-for relation, one ( 0.004 0.004 ) places it in the wrong relation, and two ( 0.008 0.008 ) the judge cannot find at all. The credit the matcher issues is therefore reliable at roughly nineteen items in twenty asserting what the question asked, with the residual split between bare naming and outright relational error about four to one. Two different questions arise on the unexposed side, and the audit answers them with different evidence. The first is whether the matcher hides correct answers it never credited: on 60 unexposed-and-uncredited items the judge finds no hidden correct relational answer ( 0 0 of 60 60 , 0.000 0.000 [ 0.000 , 0.060 ] [0.000,0.060] ), which rules out an undetected-recovery rate above about 6 % 6\% on this sample. Those units say nothing about false credit, because the matcher issued no credit on them; they are uncredited by construction. False credit is answered only by the second question, and only by the n 01 n_{01} census: all three unexposed-but-credited items in the entire frame fail relational adjudication, one naming the target without asserting the edge and two the judge cannot locate at all. Frequency and precision are separate facts here, and both are needed. Credit beyond exposure is rare, three units in 11,360 11{,}360 ; and on this census, which is every such unit there is, its precision is zero. The three-item beyond-exposure recovery of § 10.3 therefore survives the audit as noise rather than signal, though three units support no rate estimate.

blocks.en: Reweighting each matcher stratum by the judged probability that the answer asserts the gold edge moves the exposed-item rate from the matcher’s context-utilisation figure of 0.931 0.931 to an estimated 0.905 \mathbf{0.905} [ 0.884 , 0.923 ] [0.884,0.923] , a difference of 2.5 2.5 percentage points. This is an estimated correction under this adjudicator and this protocol, and not a known overstatement. Three qualifications belong beside the number. The adjudicator is a model and the demotion rule is a quote policy, so both the size and the sign of the correction inherit the judge’s own errors and that policy’s choices. Both strata are sampled rather than censused, and their observations repeat questions and gold targets across ten models, so they are not independent draws. And the denominator is lexically exposed items while the judged quantity is whether the answer asserts the gold edge, which is a property of answers, not a measure of whether the shown context was sufficient to produce them. The estimator is the frame-weighted combination of the two judged stratum rates, R = ( 9,865 ​ p 11 + 735 ​ p 10 ) / 10,600 R=(9{,}865\,p_{11}+735\,p_{10})/10{,}600 with p 11 = 233 / 240 p_{11}=233/240 and p 10 = 3 / 120 p_{10}=3/120 , and its interval comes from a stratified cluster bootstrap that resamples questions within each stratum, 184 of them in the credited stratum and 59 in the omitted one, recomputing both rates on every draw and recombining them through the same weights, at 10,000 draws and seed 42. Resampling questions rather than units is what carries the dependence between gold items of one question; clustering on model instead of question gives [ 0.886 , 0.924 ] [0.886,0.924] , so neither crossed factor dominates. Propagating the two Wilson intervals naively gives [ 0.876 , 0.922 ] [0.876,0.922] , which is reported for comparison only and is not a valid interval for this design: it adds bounds instead of resampling the joint distribution, and it ignores the clustering altogether. Across the three readings of an unresolved verdict R R moves only from 0.9052 0.9052 to 0.9054 0.9054 , so the correction does not turn on how those units are counted. The gap is small partly because the two error directions offset: credited items are occasionally not asserted, and omitted items are occasionally asserted after all. That offset is a fact about this corpus and this matcher, not a general property.

blocks.en: Three mechanisms are visible, and the first two are countable over the whole frame without any judge (Table 2 , lower panel). Subject-substring credit : on 208 credited units the gold title is a substring of the question’s own subject name, so merely restating the question earns credit. This is the weakest credit path in the audit: of the seven such units sampled, four are judged correct_relation against 0.971 0.971 overall. Run-together gold titles : seven gold titles in the frozen set write their words without spaces ( DeFi , EdDSA , GraphQL , MultiAccessEdgeComputing , OpenXR , SustainabilityReporting , WebRTC ). They are not unmatchable. Of the 70 frame units carrying one, the matcher credits 58 and omits 12 (Table 2 , lower panel), and all 58 are credited by a verbatim substring hit: the model reproduced the run-together form the scaffold put in front of it, so the normalisation’s refusal to split the title never bit. The blind spot is to the spaced expansion, not to the title, and it bites on 10 of the 12 omissions, where the answer does contain the spaced form and the matcher cannot see it (“Sustainability Reporting” for SustainabilityReporting ); the other two do not mention the item under any spelling, and there the matcher is right. The defect therefore costs 10 units of 11,360 11{,}360 , from two titles: SustainabilityReporting on one question for nine of the ten models, and MultiAccessEdgeComputing once. The remaining five are conventional unspaced names in their fields, which is why models reproduce them exactly and the matcher never misses them. All seven sampled units carrying the mechanism are judged correct_relation . Taxonomic attachment : credited-item precision is lowest on T-TAX, 0.938 0.938 [ 0.832 , 0.979 ] [0.832,0.979] against T-REL’s 0.978 0.978 [ 0.944 , 0.991 ] [0.944,0.991] , and the wrong-relation case is a model naming a correct ancestor while asserting the wrong attachment point in the hierarchy. A matcher that tests for a name cannot see the difference between a parent and a grandparent.

blocks.en: 10.4 Grounding suppresses parametric recall
blocks.zh: 10.4 对 定位抑制参数召回

blocks.en: This result needs no ceiling to state: it is a bare-versus-grounded comparison on exactly the n 01 + n 00 n_{01}+n_{00} items the scaffold does not expose, and it has the most direct operational consequence of anything in the paper. Bare, those items are not beyond the models: pooled over the ten models and the 760 unexposed gold items (76 per model), the raw arm recovers 12.1 % \mathbf{12.1\%} of them from parameters alone (92 of 760). Under injection the same items are recovered at 0.4 % \mathbf{0.4\%} (3 of 760), and seven of the ten models drop to exactly zero . Recovery without injected context therefore exceeds recovery with it on these items: the observed behaviour is suppression. Displacement of parametric knowledge by injected context, a documented tendency [ 51 , 55 , 34 ] , is the natural explanation, though absence of an item from the scaffold is omission rather than contradiction, and this design observes the effect rather than isolating its mechanism.
blocks.zh: 这一结果无需说明上限:对脚手架没有暴露的准确的n 01 + n 00 n_{01}+n_{00}物品,这是赤裸裸的和有根据的比较,它具有论文中任何内容最直接的操作后果. 零,这些物品并不超出模型范围:在10个模型和760个未接触的黄金项目(每个模型76个)上集合,生臂仅从参数(760个中的92个)中就回收了12.1%\mathbf{12.1\%}。 在注射中,同样的物品以0.4%\mathbf{0.4\%}(760年中有3件)回收,10种模型中的7种完全降到零。 因此,没有注入的恢复超过了这些物品的恢复:观察到的行为是抑制。 通过注入语境来转移参数化知识,一种有记录的趋势[51,55,34]是自然的解释,尽管脚手架上没有物品是遗漏而不是矛盾的,这种设计观察到效果而不是孤立其机制.

blocks.en: The items are gold targets from this corpus which the particular retrieved scaffold for their own question happened not to expose, assessed under this authority instruction, this confidence-gated retrieval policy and this lexical matcher. “Absent from the retrieved scaffold” is not “outside the corpus”, still less “arbitrary out-of-domain knowledge”, so nothing here licenses a claim about how a grounded model handles knowledge the corpus does not contain. Obeying an authoritative supplied source can also be the desired behaviour, making this a cost to price rather than a defect to fix. Three caveats bound the reading: the shared lexical matcher makes both rates surface proxies for paraphrased recovery; a bare-arm hit does not prove purely parametric provenance, since lexical cues in the question can contribute; and the effect is a property of this injection policy rather than of grounding in the abstract.
blocks.zh: 这些物品是本体的黄金目标,根据该当局指示评估,这些物品被取回的脚手架没有暴露这种有信心的取回政策和这个名词匹配者。 “从取回的脚手架得到的同意”不是“在书目之外”,更不是“任意的境外知识”,因此,这里没有任何内容允许就有根据的模型如何处理书目所没有的知识提出主张。 服从权威来源也可能是所期望的行为,从而使其成为代价而不是修复的缺陷。 三个提示将读法捆绑起来:共享的词典匹配器使两种表率都成为解释性恢复的代词;赤臂命中不能证明纯参数化的出处,因为问题中的词典提示可以起到促进作用;效果是这种注入政策的一个属性,而不是抽象地扎根.

blocks.en: The 92 raw-arm recoveries are lexical matches, so the gap the audit of § 10.2 opens on the scaffold arm opens here too: a bare answer can name a gold target without asserting the relation the question asked for. All 92 were therefore put to the same relational adjudicator, under the same rubric and the same quote policy. The judge calls 71 of them correct_relation ( 0.772 0.772 [ 0.676 , 0.846 ] [0.676,0.846] ), 15 a bare naming and 6 absent, with none placing the target in a wrong, reversed or negated relation; three citations needed adjudication and one of those stayed unresolved, which moves the rate no further than 0.780 0.780 . Counted as relationally validated lexical recoveries, the comparison is 71 of 760 bare against 0 of 760 grounded. Adjudication costs the bare arm 21 of its 92 credits and the grounded arm all three of its three, so the direction of the contrast survives on the validated credits; per model the bare arm’s validated count runs from 1 of 1 to 13 of 14. Because lexical negatives were not exhaustively adjudicated in either arm (60 of the 757 grounded negatives were sampled, none of the 668 bare negatives), these counts do not establish full-frame relational recovery rates, and no interval is attached to them. The contrast stated above is between two lexical scores produced by the same matcher on both arms and is unaffected by this audit; what the audit changes is how much asserted parametric knowledge the bare figure stands for.

blocks.en: The figures are computed with the paper’s own byte-identical matcher over the released sweep rows (per-model raw recovery 1–14 of 76). This is the more informative of the two observations: supplying the context is followed by loss of recall the bare model demonstrably has, a stronger statement than grounded recall merely failing to exceed a verbatim copy. The design observes the behaviour without separating its mechanisms, and the wrapper ablation that would separate them is named in the conclusion’s future work.

blocks.en: Study 2’s headline is graded by a single gpt-4.1 judge, so a residual concern is that it tracks a family-specific grading style rather than answer content. The same 114 paired answers were therefore re-judged from scratch by claude-opus-4-6 , a family used nowhere else in the paper, under the identical rubric, blinding and resume protocol. The contrast reproduces and slightly strengthens: pooled + 0.342 +0.342 (33 non-tied) against + 0.272 +0.272 , with the same per-set ordering (arcane + 1.042 +1.042 against + 0.792 +0.792 , thin + 0.400 +0.400 against + 0.300 +0.300 , general + 0.033 +0.033 against + 0.050 +0.050 , still on two to three non-tied pairs). blocks.en: Four controls test whether the live lift reflects specific knowledge transfer or merely the presence of a fluent, on-corpus block. Each holds model and question fixed while perturbing only the scaffold, fetched verbatim from the LLM-free /loom/scaffold endpoint (§ 5.4 ). The cohort is 57 frozen questions, 24 arcane and 33 thin, answered by the local Qwen3.8-27B through true , shuffled , masked and irrelevant at a 1536-token budget, with the loom and raw arms from the same day’s paired run. Its completions are released. The scores reported here come from re-judging those completions with openai/gpt-4.1 at temperature 0 under the paper’s rubric verbatim, the same judge family as Study 2’s headline; that re-judge agrees with the archived scores on 227 227 of 240 240 rows exactly and on 240 240 of 240 240 within one point of the 0 0 – 5 5 scale.

A common-intersection sensitivity analysis addresses the objection that different rows rest on different questions: repeating the whole family on the 20 questions graded in every one of the six arms leaves nothing significant under Holm, while every point estimate keeps its sign and rough magnitude (loom − - raw + 0.80 +0.80 , true − - raw + 0.60 +0.60 , true − - irrelevant + 0.40 +0.40 ). Attrition does two things here and only one of them is power. That is a statement about what the instrument can credit, not about what the models did. One scope condition holds throughout: the ≈ 0.92 \approx 0.92 grounded recall is for questions phrased in the graph’s title vocabulary, and under paraphrase the exposure ceiling itself falls to 0.328 0.328 (§ 8 ), so the headline figure is the high end of a distribution rather than a single operating point.

blocks.en: Raw uplift is large and consistent across the sweep, while gain over copy is small and uniformly negative: every model appears transformed against its bare-model baseline, none exceeds a verbatim copy of its context, and they differ chiefly in how much exposed gold they drop. Uplift therefore carries little information about the model, while gain over copy places the same ordering on an exposure-normalised scale. Its contribution is the reference point rather than a new ranking, and that is the case for reporting the accounting as standard practice.

blocks.en:
The reason an organisation
builds a node of this kind is not that a model reasons better with a graph attached to it. It is
that the organisation’s own maintained knowledge should be answerable through a model it can
replace, with control over which source is consulted, which version of that source is current, and
by what route a new assertion becomes authoritative. Selecting that material, keeping it current,
governing what may be added to it and delivering the right part of it to a given request are
substantial system responsibilities, and most of the engineering in this stack is spent on them
(§ 3.1 , § 13 ). Exposure accounting identifies which part of an
observed result those responsibilities already explain. It does not measure what they are worth to
operate, and a negative gain over copy is not an argument against them: a system can be useful
because it reliably makes maintained knowledge available through a model, whether or not its recall
exceeds what a copy of the shown material would score. Three statements can be made confidently on
this evidence: versioned curated material is served through a replaceable model interface
(§ 4 ); the scaffold supplies the gold target names for the large majority of
in-domain questions (§ 10.1 ); and each answer carries source metadata naming the
generation it was served from. Three others still need evidence: that this path is cheaper than an
alternative at matched quality; that ontology structure outperforms simpler retrieval over the same
corpus at an equal budget (§ 16 ); and that the attribution metadata is accurate at
the level of an individual answer (§ 15 ).

blocks.en: Calculate the ceiling on representative questions before selecting an architecture. A ceiling close to 1 ( 0.964 0.964 here) says answer entity names are exposed in the context. It does not say the required relation is present or that the answer needed no reasoning, so what follows is a prioritisation heuristic and not a diagnosis. Where the ceiling is high, retrieval already supplies most target coverage, so the exposure reference should be reported alongside the quality and system baselines a generative component is judged on; positive gain over copy is not a prerequisite for useful generation, and a large bare-model uplift is exactly what exposure alone predicts. Where the ceiling is low, GraphRAG-style machinery (community summaries, multi-hop traversal, GNN soft-prompts) has room to earn its keep, provided the low ceiling is not simply retrieval or vocabulary failure (§ 8 ). We suspect much reported graph-RAG gain is measured in the first setting without the subtraction; the ceiling is cheap enough to compute before expensive architecture is built.

blocks.en: Where the model’s measured recall is achievable from what the corpus supplies, it is natural to hypothesise that investment should favour upstream curation, whose cost is amortised rather than repaid per query. We state that as a hypothesis only, since this paper measures neither curation effort against query volume nor a quality-matched alternative serving path. What the instrument does support is narrower. Automated extraction candidates, such as blocks proposed by OntoCast [ 18 ] (treated here solely as a third-party upstream producer), can be evaluated through the copy ceiling of the questions they answer. A block that drives that ceiling towards 1 is name-complete under the matcher : the answer strings for those questions are present in it. That reading is weaker than completeness of the answers themselves, because the audit of § 10.2 shows name presence and asserted relation coming apart on roughly one credited item in fifty. Note the direction: the gate is name-completeness of the source, not positive gain over it, since requiring an extraction to exceed what its own source exposes would penalise faithful extraction. The gate is necessary and insufficient: term-stuffing answer names inflates the ceiling while leaving a block incoherent or wrong, so exposure coverage must complement existing CI, consistency and human-review gates.

Holding weights, prompt and GPU fixed, the paired scaffold effect is large: term resolution rises
from 0.17 to 0.55 ( 3.2 × 3.2\times ) while assertion count falls, and generation time roughly halves

names damage page matching and downstream dedup fingerprints. This remains single-configuration estimation : one podcast, ten episodes, one run per arm and one lexical

paired Loom-versus-bare contrast is least exposed because both arms share the draw. This is evidence
about where extracted knowledge lands, not a model-quality leaderboard.

blocks.en:
In place of the refused integration phase (§ 12.1 ), the write path is built from this paper’s two
instruments. Extracted, verified assertions land on
per-episode ledger pages inside the graph, written by the same VisionFlow ingest pipeline
that produced the case study above, and wikilinked to the topics they concern: readers see them
immediately through linked references, curated prose is never edited, and, because ledger pages
carry no ontology markup, nothing enters the served corpus by default. Landing is thereby separated
from promotion. A topic whose ledger accumulates evidence, or a thin page whose additions have been
judged to improve it, becomes a candidate ; candidates pass an automated pre-filter consisting
of the two instruments this paper developed, the blind before/after quality judgment of
§ 12.1 and the copy-ceiling name-completeness gate of § 11 .
Survivors reach the graph’s existing governed proposal queue 6 6 6 The governed propose/approve
write path is the ontology-bridge component of the same stack; the serving façade whose scaffold
and copy-ceiling endpoints the pre-filter reuses is the Loom repository already cited. as scored
dossiers with provenance down to assertion fingerprints, and approval triggers batched section
regeneration, which is the point at which content acquires ontology markup and becomes servable.
Direct enrichment of thin pages was evaluated as an alternative landing zone and rejected on its
judged evidence: its mean stayed negative across twenty pairs ( − 0.65 -0.65 and − 0.60 -0.60 under two
rubrics), and the section-splice mechanic could not apply at all on thirteen of them for want of
section anchors, leaving the ledger as the single landing zone. Figure 4 draws the

Read as architecture, the lifecycle is this paper’s two instruments put to work: the corpus is the
asset, every write to it is measured before it is trusted, and the same ceiling that audits the
serving layer gates admission to it. The ledger-and-served split follows the Event Sourcing / CQRS
materialised-view pattern [ 14 ] at the assertion layer : the ledger is
the append-only source of truth for extracted assertions and the regenerated sections built from it
are disposable projections, which is why a diluting projection can be discarded without data loss.
Mature curated prose predates the ledger, is retained as a source in its own right and is never
rebuilt from it, so the pattern describes the assertion layer and not the whole corpus. Promotion is
idempotent by assertion fingerprint, so the at-least-once delivery inherent to such pipelines cannot
double-promote. Nothing in this section is a measurement: it is the architecture the two measured
gates were used to choose.

blocks.en: 14 Reasoning-Budget Exhaustion
blocks.zh: 14 理由预算用尽

blocks.en:
Serving a reasoning model behind an injected scaffold introduces a measurement hazard that
conditions several reporting deviations (§ 10 ) and constrains the token budgets used
throughout. At max_tokens =1536, 42 of 234 loom/raw completions in Study 2 exhausted the
budget during reasoning and returned no text; the four negative-control arms, left at 1536,
lost 36 36 – 50 % 50\% of completions the same way (irrelevant 50.0 % 50.0\% , true 42.9 % 42.9\% , masked 41.1 % 41.1\% ,
shuffled 35.7 % 35.7\% ; the ordering does not track scaffold disorder, and no per-length analysis was
run, so we report the rates without a monotonic claim). The mechanism is a
prompt × \times reasoning-budget interaction, with input and output capacity kept distinct: the
scaffold consumes the context window , while the reasoning trace and the answer consume the
configured completion allowance ; a longer or noisier prompt induces a longer reasoning trace,
and a reasoning model that exhausts the allowance mid-trace emits nothing rather than a truncated
answer. Two consequences follow. The completion allowance must cover reasoning-plus-answer, not
answer alone: extraction in the case study uses 12,288 12{,}288 tokens and the Study 2 re-runs 4096 4096 , and
any sub- 2000 2000 -token allowance is unsafe for a reasoning backend behind a non-trivial scaffold. And
empty completions must be detected explicitly rather than scored as wrong, because the first-attempt
empty rate is itself a deployment failure signal ( 42 42 of 234 234 , 17.9 % 17.9\% ) and complete-case results
measure answer quality conditional on an answer being produced, not service effectiveness.
Temperature 0 does not guarantee deterministic remote inference: “deterministic” here refers to
scoring, scaffold generation and fixed decoding settings, not to provider-side reproducibility.

blocks.en:
A companion note 7 7 7 docs/research/companion-routing/ in the served-node repository, with its corpus, per-run reports, embedding caches, analysis scripts and manifest under uplift-results/routing/ . That note states its own release gaps: per-item rows survive for one of its three engines. measures a different instrument on a different task: a typed-decision seam in an agent runtime, where a router must choose one of 115 exposed skill rubrics or decline. A choice over shown options has no natural no-op extractor, so its baseline is constructed from a judge-free ranker with an oracle-tuned decline rule. That constructed quantity is ranker-relative: it measures a judge’s advantage over a particular baseline procedure, not the fraction of gold a fixed text exposes. The reusable part is the reporting discipline, that a choice task whose gold sits among its shown options should carry a fair baseline beside its accuracy, tuned to a real optimum and read by population rather than in aggregate. Four lessons from that note bear on any such evaluation: a coarse threshold grid stepped over the ranker’s own optimum and so overstated the
judge’s advantage against it; exclusion clauses indexed as positive evidence made turns score
highest on the very option written to reject them; aggregate accuracy concealed that the judge’s
entire advantage sat on boundary and late-clause turns and was nil on ordinary picking; and
systematic ranker–judge disagreement located a labelling error in a corpus its authors had already
reviewed.

blocks.en: • Recall rewards a verbose copier. The Study-1 metric is recall against graph-derived gold, so a model emitting the entire scaffold verbatim, gold together with arbitrary fabrications, would score at the copy ceiling. Precision against fabrication and the accuracy of the attribution metadata are unmeasured throughout. • The audit’s adjudicator is a model. Every verdict in § 10.2 is gpt-4.1 ’s, not a human’s, and that model is the same family as one of the ten swept models. The quote gate and the deterministic mechanism census bound how far a judge’s own errors can move the estimates, but they do not replace human annotation; the blind sample for that pass is released and unannotated. • Single corpus, and dependent questions. Both studies use one curated ontology in one broad domain, and the magnitudes (a 0.964 0.964 ceiling, a + 0.27 +0.27 live lift) do not transfer even though the instrument does. Questions generated from one graph cluster by class, domain and shared relation target, so the domain-clustered bootstrap addresses dependence within this corpus but fifteen domains and one corpus do not establish transfer beyond it. • Judge coverage. Study 2’s headline uses one GPT-family judge, cross-family from the candidate, and a third-family re-judge reproduces the contrast (§ 10.6 ); there is no multi-judge panel and no repeatability test across judge seeds. • The control cohort is small and the wrapper differs on one contrast. Per-arm n n is 28 28 – 56 56 after 36 36 – 50 % 50\% of control-arm completions were lost to budget exhaustion, and every contrast is computed on its own pairwise-complete question set, so the content contrasts are underpowered and the irrelevant arm is not length-matched to the true arm. The control arms all fetch the bare block from the LLM-free endpoint, so contrasts among them compare content under one common wrapper; only the loom − - true contrast is confounded by the live path’s authority preamble. • The placebo is seed-disjoint, not answer-disjoint. Disjoint seed classes can still share ancestors, relation targets and synonyms, so a donor block may expose some of the target’s gold, and the four-arm harness does not persist the injected bytes, so what each placebo exposed is not recoverable from its rows. • Semantic fallback disabled throughout. HNSW semantic retrieval is off because its document-embedding recall ( 0.816 0.816 ) falls below the 0.87 0.87 design floor, so the loom arm is lexical only; § 8 measures what that gate is worth. • Single production model. Study 2 fixes the model at Qwen3.8-27B, so its magnitude under other backends is unmeasured; the sweep varies models only on the offline scaffold. • Three excluded questions. Three thin-set questions still empty in one arm at 4096 are excluded pairwise ( n = 114 n=114 ). The rule is symmetric but the realised missingness was not (loom empty once, raw twice), and a deployment-effectiveness claim would need the empty answers scored as failures. • Local-model identity. The local backend is addressed by a compatibility alias ( qwen3.8-27B ) whose deployed checkpoint is a quantised derivative recorded in the node’s deployment notes rather than an attested reference release; provider display names elsewhere are likewise not immutable version identifiers. • Two exposure figures, not interchangeable. The macro ceiling, 0.964 0.964 , averages per-question exposed fractions; the item-pooled exposed fraction is ( n 11 + n 10 ) / N = 10,600 / 11,360 = 0.933 (n_{11}+n_{10})/N=10{,}600/11{,}360=0.933 , equivalently 1,060 1{,}060 of 1,136 1{,}136 items per model. Headline recall is macro-averaged and context utilisation is micro-averaged, so the two do not reconstruct each other. • One seed, one snapshot. Questions are sampled under seed 42 and served from one corpus generation. The bootstrap intervals estimate uncertainty under resampling of the frozen questions and do not cover corpus, snapshot, prompt or seed variation. • Reproducibility is pinned, but not complete. Every table and figure resolves to an artefact listed in the manifest at docs/research/gain-over-copy-paper/MANIFEST.md ; the evidence directories are as of commit a6d3e41f898c9c18efdf947fc4924ce93c79f4c8 and this manuscript is tagged paper-v9.2 ( https://github.com/DreamLab-AI/loom/tree/paper-v9.2/docs/research/gain-over-copy-paper ). Two items are absent from that release: the 7.9 MB scaffold index, which is corpus-derived, so a reader can check every derived number against the released rows but cannot regenerate the scaffolds themselves; and two embedding caches, excluded for size and rebuilt by their own released scripts. • Equivalence and power. The out-of-domain reading rests on an instrument near its ceiling: 58 of 60 Study-2 general pairs tie at means of 5.0 5.0 and 4.95 4.95 , so sensitivity to deterioration on harder questions is weak and the equivalence claim is confined to that instrument and set. Power figures quoted here are computed against observed effects and are therefore post hoc. • A constructed baseline is a different instrument. The copy ceiling applies to a task with a natural no-op extractor. For a task without one, such as a discriminative choice over shown options, a baseline must be constructed from a ranker with a decline rule; that quantity is ranker-relative and is not the exposure scalar of § 5 (§ 16 ).

blocks.en: Grounding evaluations whose gold derives from the injected corpus should account for exposure: classify each gold item by whether the shown context exposed it and whether the answer recovered it, report the four counts, and quote the copy ceiling as their per-item scalar. The counts distinguish dropped exposed facts from beyond-exposure recovery, which neither a bare-model baseline nor the scalar alone can do, and depend on nothing but a matcher and fixed text.

blocks.en: What that buys here is narrow and worth stating exactly. Across ten models, gain over copy is uniformly negative and beyond-exposure recovery is three items in 11,360 observations of 1,136 target instances. A large raw-to-grounded uplift therefore establishes delivery of exposed names and nothing beyond it: it does not establish reasoning, and equally does not establish its absence, because zero gain is compatible with successful reasoning over names the context already shows and with offsetting omissions and recoveries that cancel. Exposure accounting and reasoning evaluation are two instruments, and the audit of § 10.2 shows where the first one stops. Of the items the matcher credits, 2.1 % 2.1\% name the gold target without asserting the relation the question asks for or assert it wrongly. On 60 unexposed and uncredited items the judge finds no hidden correct relational answer, an interval reaching about 6 % 6\% . And all three credits the matcher issued beyond exposure fail relational adjudication, so credit beyond exposure is rare and, on that census, entirely spurious.
blocks.zh: 这里买的东西是狭义的,值得准确地说明。 在10种模式中,收益超过副本是完全负数的,在11 360次观察中,有1 136个目标实例的外部风险回收是3项。 因此,从原到原的大型提升可以提供已暴露姓名,而除此之外别无他法:它不能证明理由,也不能证明没有理由,因为零收益符合对上下文所示名称的成功推理,也符合取消的抵消遗漏和追回。 曝光会计和推理评价是两种工具,第10.2节的审计显示第一个停止的地方。 在匹配者信用项目中,2.1% 2.1% 2.1% 指定了黄金目标,而没有申明问题要求或错误地断言它的关系。 在60个未曝光和未认证的项目上,法官发现没有隐藏正确的关系答案,间隔时间约为6% 6 QQ。 超过曝光量的三种信用都失败了关系判断, 因此超出曝光量的信用是罕见的, 在这次普查中,完全是假的。

blocks.en: Three further results stand on their own. Rephrasing questions out of the graph’s title vocabulary collapses exposure from 0.964 0.964 to 0.328 0.328 , while the absence-keyed fallback built for that case fires on 2 of 506 questions: a gate keyed to finding nothing cannot detect finding the wrong thing. On gold targets this corpus contains but the retrieved scaffold did not expose, recovery falls from 0.121 0.121 bare to 0.004 0.004 grounded under this authority instruction and retrieval policy: injection is followed by loss of recall the bare model has. And a paired production study lifts judged quality by + 0.27 +0.27 pooled and + 0.79 +0.79 where curation is deepest, while the negative controls that would attribute that lift to the retrieved content do not: the served path beats no context, and whether the scaffold’s specific content matters beyond a well-formed on-corpus block is not established by those controls: complete-case contrasts describe the surviving questions, and budget-related missingness may select for question difficulty or answer characteristics, so the limitation concerns both power and potential selection bias.
blocks.zh: 另有三项成果是靠自己。 从图表标题词汇中重写问题从0.964 0.964 折叠到0.328 0.328 0.328, 而为506个问题中的2个问题而建的无键倒置:一个无法发现错误事物的门。 在金色目标上,这具尸体中含有但取回的脚手架没有暴露出来,根据这项授权指示和取回政策,从0.121 0.121赤裸下降到0.004 0.004:在注射后失去对赤裸模型的召回。 而成对的制作研究则将质量通过+0.27+0.27集合和+0.79集合进行判断,而将提升归属于检索内容的负面控制则不会:服务路径比不上上下文,以及脚手架的特定内容是否超出结构良好的公司区块,这些控制并不确定:完整案例对比描述遗留的问题,与预算相关的缺失可能选择质疑或回答特征,因此限制既涉及权力,也涉及潜在的选择偏差.

blocks.en: Cheapness, determinism and judge-freedom are bought at one price: the instrument gives up semantic discrimination, and the audit prices that trade rather than removing it. For a curated corpus the goal was never a model that reasons its way to unseen answers, but one that returns what the corpus was curated to say, with an accounting of how much of its score that explains.
blocks.zh: 廉价、决定主义和法官自由是以一个价格购买的:工具放弃语义歧视,以及交易而不是取消它的审计价格。 对于一个典狱长来说,目标从来不是一个能解释它如何不为人知的答案的模型,而是一个能够回溯典狱长所要说的话的模型,其中说明了它有多少分数可以解释。

blocks.en: Four experiments would extend the record here. (i) A human annotation pass over the 120-unit blind sample already prepared beside the audit, to place agreement and κ \kappa against the model adjudicator. (ii) A wrapper ablation on the suppressed items of § 10.4 : hold the omitted targets fixed, vary the instruction across authoritative, incomplete-context-warning, explicit-supplementation and neutral wrappers, and score by outcome type (omission, contradiction, abstention) rather than right or wrong. (iii) A multi-hop design that varies the route while holding the answer name exposed, with entity-preserving edge swaps and direction reversals, which is the instrument the accounting cannot substitute for. (iv) A repetition of the negative controls under a common retry policy intended to reduce attrition, with remaining failures reported explicitly, adding a length-matched block of random on-corpus sections as a noise floor [ 7 ] and persisting each arm’s injected bytes so the placebo’s own exposure can be measured.
blocks.zh: 四次实验会延长记录 (一) 人类注释通过在审计的同时已经编制的120个单元盲标样本,以与模型裁判员达成协议和统一标准。 (二)对第10.4节被压制项目的包装:将省略的目标固定起来,在权威、不完整的文字警告、明确补充和中性包装中更改指示,并按结果类型(排除、矛盾、弃权)而不是对或错分。 (三)一个多跳设计,在持有解答名称时会改变路由,并带有实体保边互换和方向反转,这是会计无法替代的工具. (四) 重复采用旨在减少自然减员的共同重试政策进行消极控制,并明确报告其余的故障,增加一个长相匹配的星系随机区块作为噪声底部[7],并持续每个臂注入字节,以便测量安慰剂本身的暴露程度。
